top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a complete, mature discovery chain: incretin physiology and proglucagon processing (Holst, Drucker) and identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov), with independent outcome trials confirming effects on glycaemia, weight, and cardiovascular and renal disease. It fits Physiology or Medicine, and the citation can name the therapeutic consequence without awarding drug development. The three-person allocation carries real costs: Knudsen is excluded, and Mojsov's priority over Habener is contested and not resolvable from the supplied record. I still judge it clearly better than no award.
